title: Neural Learning of Fast Matrix Multiplication Algorithms: a Geometric Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2602.21797v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We combine neural learning and geometric diagnostics to investigate the rank and border rank of the \(3\times3\) matrix-multiplication tensor \(M_3\). Using the Bhattacharya--Mesner product, we derive \textsc{MatMulNet}, a differentiable architecture encoding bilinear maps. Constrained refinement yields a length-\(23\) numerical solution with machine-precision full-tensor residual and bounded decomposition weight. Along the explored length-\(22\) branch, the residual instead decreases as the gauge-invariant weight grows. This contrast supports \(R_{\mathbb R}(M_3)=23\) as a working hypothesis. A Laurent-parametrised extension probes border rank, giving a tentative, protocol-dependent motivation to investigate \(r=19\) and the adjacent \(r=18\) case. translated_title: 神经学习快速矩阵乘法算法：一个几何视角
translated_abstract: 我们将神经学习与几何诊断相结合，研究 \(3\times3\) 矩阵乘法张量 \(M_3\) 的秩与边界秩。利用 Bhattacharya--Mesner 乘积，我们导出了 \textsc{MatMulNet}，一种编码双线性映射的可微分架构。约束精化得到了一个长度为 23 的数值解，其全张量残差达到机器精度且分解权重有界。在所探索的长度为 22 的分支上，残差反而随规范不变权重的增长而下降。这一对比支持将 \(R_{\mathbb R}(M_3)=23\) 作为工作假设。一个采用 Laurent 参数化的扩展用于探测边界秩，为研究 \(r=19\) 及相邻的 \(r=18\) 情形提供了初步的、依赖于协议的动机。对于 \(M_4\)，同样的诊断方法区分了从扰动已知方案恢复的有界数值解、结构化残差平台以及权重不断增长的近似。
tldr: 该论文提出可微分架构 MatMulNet 结合几何诊断方法探索 3×3 矩阵乘法张量的秩与边界秩，数值证据支持实数秩 R(M₃)=23 的工作假设，并为边界秩 r=19 和 r=18 的情形提供了初步研究动机。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MatMulNet, a differentiable neural architecture combined with geometric diagnostics to probe the rank and border rank of the 3×3 matrix multiplication tensor, providing numerical evidence supporting the working hypothesis R_R(M_3)=23 and tentative motivation for investigating border rank cases r=19 and r=18.
